events.round_label: Cumulative successive fundraisings (press statement, not a round)
France 2030 public money (award date not stated; announced_on = article date)

notes: [Verifier 2026-10-05] Court outcome CONFIRMED from the primary DILA BODACC bulk file PCL_BXA20260017 (snapshot 0059530a26ef..., robots OK; notices 6135 and 6140, Tribunal des activités économiques de Nanterre): on 2026-01-15 the court converted the procedure to liquidation judiciaire (liquidator Selarl C.Basse, Me Christophe Basse) and issued a 'Jugement arrêtant un plan de cession'. BODACC does not name the buyer: Eneris as cessionnaire stays unconfirmed (the 2026-01-15 10:45 generation-nt article, written before the hearing, reports Eneris withdrew its bid). Cumulative event instrument changed from equity to other, since the EUR90M includes EUR10M of France 2030 public money; the EUR90M also contains the France 2030 event, so only the latter may be counted. Currency of the EUR90M is implied by context (the same sentence gives the debt in euros). France 2030 instrument (grant vs repayable advance) is not stated. STATUS FACT (insolvency): Naarea (SIREN 882949506, Nanterre) entered redressement judiciaire on 2025-09-03 (BODACC A202501753378, published 2025-09-12; per the BODACC probe) and per the same probe a conversion to liquidation judiciaire and a plan de cession were judged on 2026-01-15 (A202600176135 / A202600176140). The BODACC detail pages and the OpenDataSoft mirror are not usable as quotable evidence (SPA shell; mirror disallowed by robots.txt), so the status is evidenced here only by press: generation-nt (2026-01-15) reports redressement judiciaire since 3 September, a EUR15M debt, and the withdrawal on 2026-01-14 of the only takeover bid (Eneris: EUR5.5M immediate funding, EUR21M 2026 budget, 65% of staff). The census says the court nevertheless ordered cession to Eneris on 2026-01-15 (Usine Nouvelle, 403, not archived); reviewer should confirm. The Annuaire (recherche-entreprises) still shows etat_administratif "A" (active) and 2026-01-15 as activity start of the establishment, which conflicts with the BODACC liquidation signal. Funding: only a cumulative press figure (about EUR90M of successive fundraisings of which EUR10M public via France 2030) is available; no individual round amounts, dates or investors found (naarea.fr does not resolve; WebSearch budget exhausted). Hence one cumulative event (must NOT be counted as a round) and one France 2030 event whose announced_on is the article date. BODACC probe lists ten capital-change notices 2022-03 to 2024-08 (flags only, no amounts). CORDIS: ENDURANCE associated partner with no EC contribution. Canada G&C and TED probes: no records.
